sentences.text:
_____________________________________________________ For Appellant(s) : Mr.
Prakash Thakuriya Pp For Respondent(s) :
_____________________________________________________
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kanwaljit Singh Ahluwalia Order 20/02/2018
The accused respondent was tried for offence under Section 7/16 of Food Adulteration Act.
On 11.10.2000 at 9:00 AM, Food Inspector was on adulteration prevention drive.
On suspicion, from the shop of accused respondent, out of 50 Kg Khoa, 750 gm of Khoa was purchased by making payment of Rs.45/-.
Thereafter, three different sample bottles were prepared of the above said Khoa, and in each bottle twenty drops of Formalin were also mixed and thereafter they were sealed.
After following due procedure, samples were sent to the Public Analyst.

After report was received,
samples were declared adulterated by the State Public Analyst.
The argument was raised before the trial court that right of the accused to get the second sample tested from Central Food Laboratory has been breached in the present case.

The trial Judge held that in the present case, though (2 of 2) [CRLLA-264/2015] the public analyst has said that the samples of Khoa were adulterated but it has been nowhere stated that same were injurious and harmful to human health.
The trial Judge further noted that the prosecution sanction Exhibit-P/18 is not a valid sanction in the eye of law as it nowhere shows application of mind on the part of sanctioning authority.
The trial Judge further stated that no independent witness was associated.
The trial court taking totality of circumstances, recorded acquittal of the accused respondent.
The findings given by the trial Judge are based on appreciation of evidence.
The impugned judgment is neither perfunctory nor perverse, rather the view formulated by the trial Judge is one view which is possible on the facts and circumstances of the case.
Hence, no interference is warranted and the present application for leave to appeal being devoid of merits is dismissed.

(KANWALJIT SINGH AHLUWALIA)J. Mak/-
